translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: Apocalipsis
book.title: Jesucrístona' bliile' Juanna' c̱he diika' zi' gak

content: Na' ka bxoxj Beena' Zaklebi to Xil'do' sey de gállina', goklli yabana' ka do gashj gor.
Na'ch ble'id' gall anjlka' zegake' lao Chioza', na' bi'e ḻegake' gall trompet.

Na'tech bla' sto anjl nox̱ee to barser de or, na' jsie' kwit daa nak ka mes de or gana' chzeygake' yala' daa zoa lao beena' chṉabia'. Na' bi'ene' yal zan kwenc̱he wzeye'n lawinna', na' gakan toz xtill' beṉ'ka' nak lall' na' Chioza' kat' choe'ḻwillgake'ne'.
Na' llen c̱he yala' daa yoo ḻoo barsera' nox̱' anjla' wyasan zejan lao Chioza' nakan txen xtill' beṉ'ka' choe'ḻwillgake'ne'.
Na' anjla' bex̱ee barsera', wlo'en yi' gaḻja' daa chi' gana' chey yala', na' bzaḻeen lo yell-lioni. Na' goshj wtin, na' gok sshag, na' wyep yes, na' wxo' wṉib yell-lioni.
Na' anjlka' gall, beṉ'ka' nox̱' trompetka', wze kwasgake' wkwell'gake'n.
Na' anjl necha' bkwelle' trompet c̱he'na', na' bxop lo yell-lioni yaj yaba na'ch yi' na' nc̱hix̱gakan chen. Na' schoo yell-lioni wyey, zi lat'zə ki gokan gashjə,
na' wyeylenan dii zan inlleb yag, na' doxen gana' de shga'.
Na' anjl wchopina' bkwell trompet c̱he'na', na' bxop ḻoo nisdo'na' to dii nak ka to yaa xen dii chaḻ'ṉiṉ. Na' zi lat'zə ki gok gashjə nisdo'na' biyakan chen.
Na' zi lat'zə ki gok gashjə bado'ka' lle' ḻoo nisdo'na' witgakb, na' ḻekzka' zi lat'zə ki gok gashjə barkwka' chda lo nisdo'na' wlliayi'.
Na' anjl wyoṉina' bkwell trompet c̱he'na' na' bxop to belj xen chaḻ'ṉiṉan, na' bxopan gana' de yaoka' na' gana' chal niska'.
Na' belj xenna' len Dii Zḻa'. Na' zi lat'zə ki gok gashjə nisa' gokan zḻa', na' beṉ' zan wit ni c̱he nis zḻa'na'.
Na' anjl wdapina' bkwelle' trompet c̱he'na', na' zi lat'zə ki gok gashjə wbilla' na' beo'do'na' na'ch beljdo'ka' wnit beeni' c̱heyinka'. Na' bich bzeeni'gakan zi lat'zə ki gok shgobill na' gashj yel.
Na'ch ni zej chwia' na' benid' to bsia chzob gchoḻ xan yabana' na' wṉeb zillj inlleb, nab: ―¡Nyesh'laz gak c̱he beṉ' yell-lioka' kat' wkwell anjlka' tompetka' zi shoṉ!

footnotes.text: Zi lat'zə ki gokan gashjə: literalmente la tercera parte.
